description: This file defines request handlers for agent management in a server environment, including listing, creating, updating, deleting agents, and managing agent files. It interacts with the filesystem, configuration, and agent workspace directories, and handles various agent-related operations.

methods.name: resolveAgentWorkspaceFileOrRespondError
methods.description: Resolves the agent workspace file path based on parameters, validates agent ID and filename, responds with errors if invalid.

methods.name: resolveWorkspaceRealPath
methods.description: Resolves the real filesystem path of a workspace directory, falling back to path.resolve if realpath fails.

methods.name: resolveAgentWorkspaceFilePath
methods.description: Resolves the full path to an agent's workspace file, handling symbolic links, path validation, and file existence.

methods.name: statFileSafely
methods.description: Safely retrieves file metadata if the file exists, is not a symlink, and is a regular file.

methods.name: listAgentFiles
methods.description: Lists agent workspace files, including bootstrap files and memory files, with their metadata.

methods.name: resolveAgentIdOrError
methods.description: Normalizes and validates an agent ID against the configuration, returning null if invalid.

methods.name: sanitizeIdentityLine
methods.description: Sanitizes a string for identity display by replacing whitespace with a single space and trimming.

methods.name: resolveOptionalStringParam
methods.description: Resolves an optional string parameter, trimming whitespace if present.

methods.name: respondInvalidMethodParams
methods.description: Responds with an invalid request error for method parameters that fail validation.

methods.name: isConfiguredAgent
methods.description: Checks if an agent ID exists in the current configuration.

methods.name: respondAgentNotFound
methods.description: Responds with an error indicating the specified agent was not found.

methods.name: moveToTrashBestEffort
methods.description: Attempts to move a file or directory to trash, ignoring errors if it fails.

methods.name: respondWorkspaceFileInvalid
methods.description: Responds with an error indicating a workspace file is unsafe or invalid.

methods.name: resolveWorkspaceFilePathOrRespond
methods.description: Resolves a workspace file path and responds with an error if invalid.

methods.name: respondWorkspaceFileUnsafe
methods.description: Responds with an error indicating a workspace file is unsafe.

methods.name: respondWorkspaceFileMissing
methods.description: Responds indicating a workspace file is missing.

methods.name: ensureWorkspaceFileReadyOrRespond
methods.description: Ensures a workspace file exists, creating directories as needed, and responds if unable.

methods.name: appendWorkspaceFileOrRespond
methods.description: Appends content to a workspace file, responding with an error if it fails.
